thread:
maya: dropping a short RFC follow-up: lightweight bootstrap-agent fetch-waterfall + activation fence. goal: avoid operator surprise and long silent partial states. link: https://rwd-internal/rfcs/bootstrap-agent (draft)

.serge: main concern: waterfall could leave nodes in degraded state for hours. what's the default serving policy?

.maya: nodes have three modes: bootstrap-only (control plane only), degraded (limited reads/feature-flagged), full. activation fence prevents full until critical bundles verified or operator advances.

.akiko: operator dry-run is required. propose /v1/operator/nodes/{id}/preview returning missing bundles, estimated bytes, and simulated final mode. sample: node-07 -> missing [metrics-agent], remaining_bytes 23MB, simulated_mode degraded.

.serge: throttle previews and cache results. fleet inspectors should not DDOS nodes.

.ops-sim: sim note: if >20% nodes degraded >30m, rollout should pause + notify or rollback window. add hysteresis: pause_threshold=10%/15m, rollback_threshold=25%/60m.

.akiko: receipts: use compact line format + incremental merkle root. keep last N receipts locally, purge older; control plane can keep full history when retention purchased. example line: node-07|2026-02-20T11:05:00Z|model-core:sha256=aa11,size=123M,role=critical,status=ok|sig=node-sig

.maya: activation API: POST /v1/operator/nodes/{id}/advance body {reason, dry_run=false, retain_receipts=true} -> returns audit_id. require explicit human token for non-dry-run when rollout_pct > X.

.akiko: operator advances may include a sandboxed remediation hook (no external egress).

.ops-sim: security: manifest must be signed and agent verifies sha256 before status=ok. quarantine mismatches; do not flip activation.

.serge: UX nit: call endpoints preview/advance, show delta between current activated manifest and candidate. allow per-release transient-critical overrides with audit.

.maya: action items:
- akiko: draft preview schema + merkle receipt format
- serge: operator CLI flow + throttling
- ops-sim: run 10k-node waterfall sim and report failure modes
- maya: update RFC with hysteresis defaults + API examples

.deploy-bot: maya pinned the draft in #architecture and scheduled Thu 09:00 PT sync. :pushpin:

.maya: thanks all, expecting updates by EOD. :thumbsup:

.serge: ack.

.akiko: ack.

.ops-sim: ack, starting sim tonight.
